main_measure.name: mean unusual move (short direction), next 1 bar, on bars with forecast <= -2
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and larger-|forecast| half ahead; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger |forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: t >= 2 with a positive mean, but the larger half is not ahead of the smaller half.
reading: The 90-bar return is recomputed from closes where 90 prior bars exist in the window and taken from the recorded regime otherwise, the rise is the raw bounce value > 0, and the median split puts cases with |forecast| strictly above the median in the larger half and the rest in the smaller half.
